basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Architecture and Planning, Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee, needs one Project Assistant for the project "Integrated Livelihood, Renewable Energy, and Environmental Resilience Initiative for Rural Communities of Uttarakhand", sponsored by ISEF, for a duration of 2 month with emoluments of Rs. 26000/-. Graduates with a minimum of 4 years of work experience and a good command over MS Office can apply. Applications go to the office of the Principal Investigator by email, by post or in person at the interview, and must be submitted by 16 November 2026 by 5 PM. The position

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. The essential qualification for the Project Assistant post is: Graduation with minimum 4 year of work experience Good command over MS Office When describing experience in the application, the notice asks for experience including research, industrial field and others. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience. Candidates must make sure they are eligible before appearing for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The overall management of the Project. Provide administration and organization support to ensure the successful execution of projects. Coordination with internal teams and other departments to meet project goals within the designated timeline.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Project Assistant
content_sections.text: There is no online form. Candidates who want to appear for the interview submit their application to the office of the Principal Investigator in one of three ways: by email to [email protected] , by post to the office of the Principal Investigator (Prof. Avlokita Agrawal), Department of Architecture and Planning, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee, or by producing it at the time of the interview. The last date for submission to the office of the Principal Investigator is 16 November 2026 by 5 PM, either in hard copy or by email. Application on plain paper with a detailed CV, including the chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained Experience, including research, industrial field and others Attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate Original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s), to be brought to the interview for verification

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The interview will be held in the VR Lab, Annex-01 of the Department of Architecture and Planning, IIT Roorkee. The date and time of the interview will be notified to shortlisted candidates through email. Candidates must bring their original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) to the interview for verification. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Roorkee Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Project Assistant post in the Department of Architecture and Planning, IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted to the office of the Principal Investigator by 16 November 2026 by 5 PM, in hard copy or by email.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIT Roorkee Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need graduation with minimum 4 year of work experience and a good command over MS Office.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Roorkee Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The emoluments for the Project Assistant post are Rs. 26000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IIT Roorkee Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Send an application on plain paper with a detailed CV, experience details and attested copies of certificates to the office of the Principal Investigator by email to [email protected], by post, or produce it at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the IIT Roorkee Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview in the VR Lab, Annex-01 of the Department of Architecture and Planning; the date and time will be emailed to shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the IIT Roorkee Project Assistant appointment?
faq.answer: The project position is for a duration of 2 month under the ISEF-sponsored project on rural communities of Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is any preference given to reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for the IIT Roorkee Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Only Indian nationals who meet the qualification of graduation with minimum 4 year of work experience and a good command over MS Office can apply.
